cohort: 32 patients who underwent EOH out of 7,968 deliveries at a tertiary care hospital in Karachi, Pakistan from March 2015 to March 2017
finding: The main reasons for emergency obstetric hysterectomy (EOH) were uterine atony and morbidly adherent placenta.
mod_finding: The main mode of delivery among women who underwent EOH was caesarean section (80%), mostly done as an emergency procedure (81%).
